title: Ballot version 3: the committed vote over a poll's questions, its hashes and validity proofs
generator: Printed by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-v3-vectors.py, an implementation of docs/spec/ballot-validity.md (Ballot record (version 3)) with Python's integers and hashlib, sharing no code with packages/crypto; it reuses ballot-validity-vectors.py's ristretto255, Pedersen and disjunctive-proof code and definition-v5-vectors.py's definitions. Every valid ballot is checked by its verifier and every share by the share check before printing, and every invalid vector is checked to fail with the code it lists. The randomness is SHA-512 of fixed labels: test data only.
